premise: Dog's beach ball rolls away to the water; he gets splashed chasing it, Seal pops up and nudges it back, and the two of them play ball across the waves.
inspiration: The lost-and-returned motif of folk tale (the golden ball at the well), freed of any bargain: the stranger who brings it back just wants to play.
lesson: A lost thing can bring a new friend.

en-US.title: The Ball and the Seal
en-US.text: {dog:enter} Dog had a {ball:enter} {ball:go to dog} ball, red and yellow and blue and white, and he loved it more than anything. {dog:face happy} He nudged it with his nose. {sfx:boing} Boing! {ball:go to shore} Away it rolled, bouncing down to the water's edge. {dog:face surprised} [excited] Come back, ball! {dog:go to ball} Dog raced after it. SPLASH! A wave splashed him from his nose to his tail. {dog:live shake} Dog shook himself, shake, shake, shake! [short pause] {ball:live rock} The ball sat bobbing in the foam. {seal:enter by swim} Then a grey head popped up. {seal:go to ball by swim} It was Seal. {seal:face happy} She gave the ball a push with her nose, {ball:go to dog} and it rolled right back to Dog. {ball:live spin} It spun round, and stopped at his paws. {dog:face happy} {dog:live play-bow} Dog gave it a {ball:go to seal} nudge back. Seal {ball:go to dog} pushed it back again. {seal:live clap} She clapped her flippers. Arf! [laughs] And that's how Dog found out that seals are very, very good at ball.

es-ES.title: La pelota y la foca
es-ES.text: {dog:enter} Perro tenía una {ball:enter} {ball:go to dog} pelota, roja, amarilla, azul y blanca, y la quería más que a nada. {dog:face happy} Le dio un empujoncito con el hocico. {sfx:boing} ¡Boing! {ball:go to shore} Y allá se fue, botando hasta la orilla. {dog:face surprised} [excited] ¡Vuelve, pelota! {dog:go to ball} Perro salió corriendo detrás. ¡CHOF! Una ola lo mojó del hocico a la cola. {dog:live shake} Perro se sacudió, ¡sacude, sacude, sacude! [short pause] {ball:live rock} La pelota se mecía en la espuma. {seal:enter by swim} Entonces asomó una cabeza gris. {seal:go to ball by swim} Era Foca. {seal:face happy} Empujó la pelota con el hocico, {ball:go to dog} y la pelota rodó hasta Perro. {ball:live spin} Dio vueltas y se paró junto a sus patas. {dog:face happy} {dog:live play-bow} Perro se la devolvió de un {ball:go to seal} empujoncito. Foca {ball:go to dog} se la devolvió otra vez. {seal:live clap} Dio palmadas con las aletas. ¡Arf! [laughs] Y así descubrió Perro que las focas juegan a la pelota muy, muy bien.

ja-JP.title: ボールと アザラシさん
ja-JP.text: {dog:enter}イヌくんは、{ball:enter}{ball:go to dog}ビーチボールをもっていました。あか、きいろ、あお、しろのボール。なによりも、だいすきなボールです。{dog:face happy}はなで、ちょんとつつくと…{sfx:boing}ぽーん！{ball:go to shore}ボールは、ころころ、ぽんぽん、水ぎわまでころがっていきました。{dog:face surprised}[excited]「まってー、ボール！」 {dog:go to ball}イヌくんは、おいかけました。ざぶーん！波が、はなのさきからしっぽまで、ばしゃーっ。{dog:live shake}イヌくんは、ぶるぶるぶるっ！[short pause]{ball:live rock}ボールは、白いあわのなかで、ぷかぷか。{seal:enter by swim}そのとき、はいいろの頭が、ひょっこり。{seal:go to ball by swim}アザラシさんです！{seal:face happy}アザラシさんがはなでボールをおすと、{ball:go to dog}ボールは、イヌくんのほうへ、ころころ。{ball:live spin}くるくるまわって、イヌくんのあしもとで、ぴたり。{dog:face happy}{dog:live play-bow}イヌくんは、{ball:go to seal}ちょんとおしかえしました。アザラシさんも、{ball:go to dog}またおしかえします。{seal:live clap}ひれで、ぱちぱち。オウッ！[laughs]こうしてイヌくんは、しったのです。アザラシって、ボールあそびが、とってもとってもじょうずなんだって。

de-DE.title: Der Ball und die Robbe
de-DE.text: {dog:enter} Der Hund hatte einen {ball:enter} {ball:go to dog} Wasserball, rot und gelb und blau und weiß, und den liebte er über alles. {dog:face happy} Er stupste ihn mit der Nase an. {sfx:boing} Boing! {ball:go to shore} Und weg hüpfte der Ball, hopp, hopp, bis hinunter ans Ufer. {dog:face surprised} [excited] „Komm zurück, Ball!“ {dog:go to ball} Der Hund rannte hinterher. PLATSCH! Eine Welle machte ihn nass, von der Nase bis zur Schwanzspitze. {dog:live shake} Der Hund schüttelte sich, schüttel, schüttel, schüttel! [short pause] {ball:live rock} Der Ball schaukelte im Schaum. {seal:enter by swim} Da tauchte ein grauer Kopf auf. {seal:go to ball by swim} Es war die Robbe. {seal:face happy} Sie gab dem Ball mit der Nase einen Schubs, {ball:go to dog} und er rollte geradewegs zurück zum Hund. {ball:live spin} Er drehte sich und blieb genau vor seinen Pfoten liegen. {dog:face happy} {dog:live play-bow} Der Hund gab ihm einen {ball:go to seal} Stups zurück. Die Robbe {ball:go to dog} schubste ihn wieder zurück. {seal:live clap} Sie klatschte mit den Flossen. Ark, ark! [laughs] Und so fand der Hund heraus, dass Robben ganz, ganz toll Ball spielen können.

fr-FR.title: Le ballon et le phoque
fr-FR.text: {dog:enter} Chien avait un {ball:enter} {ball:go to dog} ballon tout rond, rouge, jaune, bleu et blanc, et il l’aimait plus que tout au monde. {dog:face happy} Il l’a poussé du bout du museau. {sfx:boing} Boïng ! {ball:go to shore} Et le voilà parti, en rebondissant jusqu’au bord de l’eau. {dog:face surprised} [excited] « Reviens, ballon ! » {dog:go to ball} Chien a couru derrière lui. PLOUF ! Une vague l’a arrosé du bout du museau jusqu’au bout de la queue. {dog:live shake} Chien s’est secoué : brrr, brrr, brrr ! [short pause] {ball:live rock} Le ballon se balançait dans l’écume. {seal:enter by swim} Puis une tête grise a surgi. {seal:go to ball by swim} C’était Phoque. {seal:face happy} Il a poussé le ballon avec son nez, {ball:go to dog} et le ballon a roulé jusqu’à Chien. {ball:live spin} Il a tourné, tourné, et il s’est arrêté pile entre ses pattes. {dog:face happy} {dog:live play-bow} Chien le lui a renvoyé d’un petit {ball:go to seal} coup de museau. Phoque {ball:go to dog} le lui a relancé. {seal:live clap} Il a tapé des nageoires. Arf, arf ! [laughs] Et c’est comme ça que Chien a découvert que les phoques sont très, très forts au ballon.

it-IT.title: Il pallone e la foca
it-IT.text: {dog:enter} Cane aveva un {ball:enter} {ball:go to dog} pallone, rosso, giallo, blu e bianco, e gli voleva bene più di ogni altra cosa. {dog:face happy} L'ha spinto col naso. {sfx:boing} Boing! {ball:go to shore} E via, è rotolato giù saltellando fino alla riva. {dog:face surprised} [excited] «Torna qui, pallone!» {dog:go to ball} Cane gli è corso dietro. SPLASH! Un'onda l'ha bagnato dalla punta del naso alla punta della coda. {dog:live shake} Cane si è scrollato, scrolla, scrolla, scrolla! [short pause] {ball:live rock} Il pallone dondolava nella schiuma. {seal:enter by swim} Poi è spuntata una testa grigia. {seal:go to ball by swim} Era Foca. {seal:face happy} Ha dato una spinta al pallone col naso, {ball:go to dog} e il pallone è rotolato dritto fino a Cane. {ball:live spin} Ha fatto un giro su se stesso, e si è fermato tra le sue zampe. {dog:face happy} {dog:live play-bow} Cane gliel'ha rimandato con una {ball:go to seal} spintarella. Foca {ball:go to dog} gliel'ha rimandato ancora. {seal:live clap} Ha battuto le pinne. Arf! [laughs] Ed è così che Cane ha scoperto che le foche sono bravissime, ma proprio bravissime, a giocare a palla.

zh-TW.title: 會玩球的海豹
zh-TW.text: {dog:enter}小狗有一顆{ball:enter}{ball:go to dog}沙灘球，紅的、黃的、藍的、白的，牠最最喜歡這顆球了。{dog:face happy}牠用鼻子頂一頂。{sfx:boing}蹦！{ball:go to shore}球蹦蹦跳跳，一路滾到水邊去了。{dog:face surprised}[excited]「球球，快回來呀！」 {dog:go to ball}小狗拔腿就追。嘩啦！一道浪打過來，把牠從鼻子濕到尾巴。{dog:live shake}小狗用力甩一甩，甩、甩、甩！[short pause]{ball:live rock}球在白白的浪花裡，一搖一晃。{seal:enter by swim}這時候，有個灰灰的頭從水裡冒了出來。{seal:go to ball by swim}是海豹！{seal:face happy}牠用鼻子推了球一下，{ball:go to dog}球就一路滾回小狗那裡。{ball:live spin}球轉呀轉，剛好停在小狗的腳邊。{dog:face happy}{dog:live play-bow}小狗開心極了，把球{ball:go to seal}頂回去。海豹{ball:go to dog}又推回來。{seal:live clap}牠開心地拍拍鰭，嗷！嗷！[laughs]就這樣，小狗發現了一件事：海豹玩起球來，真的好厲害、好厲害！

zh-HK.title: 沙灘波和海豹
zh-HK.text: {dog:enter}小狗有一個{ball:enter}{ball:go to dog}沙灘波，紅、黃、藍、白四種顏色，牠愛它愛得不得了。{dog:face happy}牠用鼻子頂了一頂。{sfx:boing}嘣！{ball:go to shore}沙灘波一彈一彈，滾到了岸邊。{dog:face surprised}[excited]「返嚟呀，波波！」 {dog:go to ball}小狗追了過去。嘩啦！一個浪撲過來，把牠從鼻子濕到尾巴。{dog:live shake}小狗用力抖，抖、抖、抖！[short pause]{ball:live rock}沙灘波在白色的泡沫裏一浮一浮。{seal:enter by swim}這時，水裏冒出一個灰色的頭。{seal:go to ball by swim}原來是海豹！{seal:face happy}牠用鼻子把波一推，{ball:go to dog}沙灘波就一直滾回小狗那邊。{ball:live spin}它轉呀轉，停在小狗的腳邊。{dog:face happy}{dog:live play-bow}小狗用鼻子{ball:go to seal}頂回去。海豹又{ball:go to dog}推回來。{seal:live clap}牠拍拍鰭：嗷嗷！[laughs]就這樣，小狗發現了：原來海豹玩起波來，真是非常、非常厲害！

boing.prompt: a beach ball bouncing once on sand, a soft rubbery boing, playful
